1.body:
Hello,

I am applying for the UX Designer role I saw posted for Ncantotech, drawn to your work helping startups and established enterprises achieve their UX goals across diverse digital platforms.

During my UI/UX internship at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing, fed findings back into user flows, and worked closely with developers on smooth design-to-development handoff. At Ascent Business Solutions, I also built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut repetitive work and turnaround time.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, which you can review directly in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a brief fifteen-minute call to discuss how my background fits your agency's current design projects?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/
